app people (/apps/people)
  audience everyone
  page /contact  require *
  page /home  require *
  page /users/add  require staff, hr
  page /users/{login}/contacts  require staff  guard
  page /users/{login}/info  require staff  shared
  calls contacts: Contacts
  database
  files photos
  email from people@acme.example to acme.example
  settings team_address
  writes INSERT users
  surface 5 (5 entry points, 2 effects)
  local note: dev.yaml names no workspace at or above this folder, so aicoded dev runs the apps here with its defaults: no local MySQL server, no local values, and the personas all-roles and no-roles; howto E-DEV-002 shows the format of dev.yaml
  local mysql not set
  local setting team_address not set
